culprit_citations.quoted_text: Fair Value 5,156,571; Percentage of Total Net Assets 176%

findings.detail: The filing reports percentage of net assets as whole percentages, so a tight exact-value identity incorrectly flags legitimate rounding.

rationale: The filing's schedule reports fair value of 5,156,571 (thousand) and 176% of net assets, while the balance sheet reports net assets of 2,934,192 (thousand). The exact ratio is 175.740749%, which rounds to the disclosed whole-percent value of 176%. Table 77 likewise presents category percentages as whole numbers. The 54.78% violation rate is therefore consistent with the identity check applying tighter precision than the raw source provides, not with erroneous extracted percentages.
